articles.title: The Oyster Helpers of Chesapeake Bay
articles.summary: Oysters clean Chesapeake Bay water and shelter other creatures, but their numbers fell sharply. John Consoli, his neighbours, and robot researchers are working to bring them back.

articles.title: Election Night: Polls Close and Counting Begins
articles.summary: On Tuesday, polls close in waves from 7 p.m. to 1 a.m. Eastern Time. Close Senate races may decide control, and some counting could last days or weeks.

articles.title: Families Come Together Again After Leaving Oleshky
articles.summary: People from Oleshky crossed into Ukrainian-held land during a short ceasefire, travelling through Russia and Belarus. Families and aid groups waited to welcome them on Saturday.
